text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: So, who are you thinking?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Mmm... Probably Vodka, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
No way. Did you see Daiwa Scarlet's
pre-race
interview? She's ready to
rumble.

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
I hear you, but it's gotta be Aston
Machan. She
was amazing in the Fillies'
Revue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a three-way clash with no clear
favorite.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Amidst a dotted pink halo of blooming
cherry
blossoms, the crowd at Hanshin
Racecourse waits
with bated breath for
the race to begin.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I've thoroughly researched all of
Machan's races. I
know all about how
explosive Vodka can be. I've
got my
strategy in place.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I will win today!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Rrraaaghhh! Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I've done everything I can to prepare!
All that's
left is to get out there and do
this thing!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If Scarlet and Machan wanna duke it
out, I'm
ready for 'em. I'll fight to the
very last step!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: This race is mine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The tension in each waiting room is
palpable. As
for Aston Machan...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Nnngh...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I thought spring and I had worked things
out, but
it seems I was mistaken.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I've been restless since yesterday. All
wriggly and
fidgety.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That goes without saying. I would race
even if the
sky started falling.
choice_data_list: Do you think you can make it to the race?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All the same, I'm worried about sending
her out
there in this state. Is there
anything I can do to
put her at ease?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I dump everything out of my bag and, as
luck
would have it, a piece of candy falls
out. I go to
hand it to her,
but—unsurprisingly...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Oh, I feel dizzy. My legs are weak...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...No, I have to ignore it all for now. It's
not there
if I don't acknowledge it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
There's going to be a thousand eyes on
the turf
today to witness a legend being
born.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Which means...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Even if spring turns its back on me, I'm still going to win!
